messages:
maria: Quick checklist before we hand off the automatic fallback policy editor to design. Need minimal items.
ajay: two flows: route-level rules + org/global defaults. UI must show which takes precedence.
devon: backend: store policy decisions as small objects (decision_id) so audit rows can reference them rather than duplicating rules.
sarah: show a compact 'why' pill in the preview (trigger type + summary). also include a simulated request input.
linus: SRE wants sampling rate, last-fired ts, and reconciliation status (did fallback actually help?).
maria: operator override: one-click takeover that records operator id, reason, TTL. cooldown per operator to avoid flip-flops.
ajay: telemetry events we need: policy_evaluated, policy_fired, policy_reconciled, operator_override, audit_viewed. include example payloads in the API doc.
ops-bot: staging endpoint `/staging/autofallback/preview` live. Use header `X-Test-Policy: p_test` to simulate.
maria: OK I'll make tickets: API contract for audit rows, mock data for design, SRE acceptance criteria (latency, retention). tagging @sarah @devon for handoff. :thumbsup:
